ea63fdeffee79ca90f7b216157d3c83ae2292de3.caption: Overview of the content areas of the web grid at four breakpoints, Breakpoint S, Breakpoint M, Breakpoint L and Breakpoint XL, each with one or two example screens. Breakpoint S covers 320px minimum to 767px, Breakpoint M 768px to 1023px, Breakpoint L 1024px to 1535px, and Breakpoint XL starts at 1536px and is also shown at an example size of 2560px. Each screen stacks coloured bars labelled Full, Extended and Main, then rows of halves, thirds, two thirds and quarters, then Narrow Center and Narrow Left bars; at XL on the 2560px screen Extended and Main stay centred and narrower than the Full bar.

f7f5d0a312f4658c34e437d28b0c8cf6c0993e5b.caption: Grid Web Sidebar specification as column strips for four breakpoints. Breakpoint S: most used screen 360px, range 320-767px, usage mobile, gutter 16px, margin 24px, 8 columns, @mixin ds-grid. Breakpoint M: most used screen 768px, range 768-1023px, usage tablet, gutter 24px, margin 36px, 12 columns, @mixin ds-grid. Breakpoint L: most used screen 1024px, range 1024-1535px, usage desktop small, gutter 24px, margin 50px, 12 columns, @mixin ds-grid-sidebar. Breakpoint XL: most used screen 1536px, range 1535px+, usage desktop medium, gutter 32px, margin 64px, 12 columns, @mixin ds-grid-sidebar. L and XL each show two strips, one centred without sidebar and one with a left area for the open Sidebar Menu. A warning "Right margin in Figma vs. Code" under L and XL says Figma sets the right margin with the Sidebar Menu open to 58px (L) and 72px (XL) to keep column widths consistent, because Figma cannot stretch columns with sidebars, while code uses the intended 50px (L) and 64px (XL).
